text: Why don't we just fill a rocket with our trash and dump it in the Sun?
The Sun is huge. Hard to miss.
But Earth moves sideways at thirty kilometers a second, and the rocket keeps that speed.
So it misses, and circles the Sun.
To actually hit it, you have to cancel that speed. That takes fifty-five times more energy than going to Mars.
And we make over two billion tonnes of trash a year. That's at least eighty million full rockets. Every year.
